# Historical validation fixtures

These five byte-preserved validation records remain inputs to active package integrity tests and staging cleanup. Full frozen source is in [the pinned archive](https://github.com/mateo-cogeanu/ps5-homebrew-history/tree/aa7db35ee9aa5cc6515f49b23ebda6d1ecfcf91d/prosperocraft). File hashes and original paths are in its manifest. Keep these records unchanged; do not replace console evidence with host build results. Local ignored milestone packages remain regression inputs to older package tests.
